report:
Lung, left upper lobe, lobectomy

The specimen consists of a left upper lobe lobectomy specimen (210 g, 160 x 120 x 50 mm). The pleural surface is smooth and glistening. Sectioning reveals a firm, grey-white, ill-defined tumour measuring 12 mm in greatest dimension, subpleural, 40 mm from the bronchial margin. The ill-defined fibrotic tumour bed measures 30 x 25 x 22 mm.

(1-6) Tumour bed, entirely embedded.
(7) Bronchial margin, shave.
(8) Vascular margin, shave.
(9-10) Lymph nodes, station 5.
(11-12) Lymph nodes, station 11L.
(13) Background lung.

Specimen and tumour
- Procedure: Lobectomy
- Laterality: Left
- Lobe(s): Upper lobe
- Tumour site: Peripheral
- Tumour size: 12 mm in greatest dimension
- Invasive size (lepidic component excluded): 12 mm (no lepidic component)
- Separate tumour nodule(s): Not identified
- Pleural surface (gross): Unremarkable

Microscopic findings
- Histologic type: Invasive adenocarcinoma, solid predominant (solid 80 %,
  acinar 20 %)
- Histologic grade: Grade 3 (IASLC 2020; solid predominant, 80 % high-grade
  patterns)
- Tumour histology:
  The tumour bed (30 mm) shows extensive fibrosis, foamy histiocytes and cholesterol clefts with residual viable carcinoma occupying about 8 % of the bed; the largest contiguous focus of viable tumour measures 12 mm. Immunohistochemistry: TTF-1 positive, p40 negative.
- Spread through air spaces (STAS): Not identified
- Visceral pleura invasion: Not identified
- Lymphatic and / or vascular invasion: Not identified
- Tumour extension: Not applicable
- Treatment effect: 10 % or less residual viable tumour (8 % viable tumour)

Margins
- Bronchial margin: Uninvolved by invasive carcinoma (closest distance 40 mm)
- Vascular margin: Uninvolved by carcinoma
- Parenchymal margin: Not applicable

Lymph nodes
- Regional lymph nodes: 6 examined; 0 involved
  - Stations (involved/examined): 5: 0/2; 11L: 0/4
  - Number examined: 6
  - Number involved: 0

Distant metastasis
- Distant metastasis: Not applicable

Pathological stage (AJCC 9th edition)
- pTNM: ypT1b ypN0
  - Stage group (if cM0): IA2

Additional findings
- Additional notes: Resection after three cycles of neoadjuvant
  chemo-immunotherapy
